title: funkia cordata
intro: Funkia cordata, commonly known as the Bleeding Heart, is a perennial flowering plant native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Funkia cordata are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Funkia cordata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
